answer: Each new identity must anchor to three unique notarized attestations from existing members; each attestation permanently burns one non-transferable voucher slot held by the attestor, paid by the applicant as a 6-token fee per slot. N fake identities consume 3N slots and cost 18N tokens, linear. The registry verifies signatures; any key reset voids the anchor and offers no haven, requiring fresh attestations. A violet record marks each burned slot.
